what: a 120 x 90 tray with four 20 mm 90 degree flanges and corner relief shape tear, unfolded
method: a flange of angle th, outer leg length Hf (height, from the virtual sharp along the flange) bends with allowance BA = th(R+Kt) and bend deduction BD = 2(R+t)tan(th/2) - BA; unfolded it lies in the base's plane and reaches Hf - BD beyond the base's edge. T = 2, R = 1, K = 0.5. BD(90) = 2*3 - pi = 2.8584, so the flat reaches 20 - BD = 17.1416 past each edge of the base: bbox x from -17.1416 to 137.1416, y from -17.1416 to 107.1416, z 0..2 (the base keeps its place); the corner relief changes the outline only inside the corners
